reason: Retain consensus, durability, learner-vote, joint-membership, Ready and replication safety. Strengthen automatic leave and configuration/zero-payload admission, add missing configuration-callback and source-boundary obligations, migrate payload/progress observations, and repair specific old property defects. Do not weaken requirements to hide implementation mismatches.

If not trigger, afterHist=beforeHist and after.pendingConf=before.pendingConf. The applied cursor and preservation requirements remain in AckPreservation. Require quotaAfter=max(0,quotaBefore-Weight(batch.committed)).

For an eligible leader, process entries left to right using a local pending cursor P initially equal to before.pendingConf and the unchanged pre-application configuration C. A configuration entry is rewritten to an empty normal entry iff P>applied OR (C is joint AND the entry is not an actual LeaveJoint) OR (C is not joint AND the entry is an actual LeaveJoint). Actual LeaveJoint means V2, no changes, Transition=Auto, ignoring Context; legacy AsV2 always contains one change, including NodeID=0. Rewriting must not advance P. Otherwise preserve the configuration entry and set P=beforeLast+batchPosition. Preserve normal entries. Decide quota from the whole effective batch using the positive-weight condition in OutcomeSoundness. On Accepted append exactly that batch, preserving content, payload weight and encoded size, assigning current term and consecutive indices; after.pendingConf=P. On quota drop the log is unchanged (the separate pending-on-drop concern remains unresolved). Retain the old role/forwarding/transfer behavior. Do not redefine LeaveJoint as merely len(Changes)=0.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Learner voting in the newly added interaction regression
already_covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: VoteObservation records ordinary freshness/term/vote inputs and exact emitted response; VoteContract does not prohibit learner grants. history.campaigns separately prohibits learner-originated campaigns, and JointWon counts only each candidate/leader configuration. This behavior was already implemented in old/source; the new trace is not permission to rewrite learner eligibility.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Joint configuration effects, staged demotions, explicit versus automatic leave, full recovery
already_covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: EffectObservation binds the committed entry and its request to the full before/after config; ConfigCandidate stages outgoing demotions in learnersNext and LeaveJoint promotes them to learners. ConfigOf and recovery.expectedConfig include incoming, outgoing, learners, learnersNext and autoLeave. Numeric progress initialization must migrate without projecting away ConfState.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Advance preserves output generated after Ready and stabilizes only its batch
already_covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: history.acks contains before/after log, snapshot indices, output bags, read states and prevSS. AckPreservation already allows one appended empty-change V2 and preserves later output/snapshots, so nil payload does not invalidate it. readyChecks already forbids quota release at Ready and constrains page cursor. Neither predicate alone checks auto-leave eligibility/pending cursor; the separate modification is essential.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Campaign recipient set and joint quorum despite deterministic sorting
already_covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: CampaignRequests computes new output-message multiplicities and exact recipients from the union of voter halves. Sorting leaves this bag unchanged. QuorumAccounting uses both halves for wins and commits. Only the erroneous self-quorum shortcut needs repair; a separate source sequence observer can check emission order.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Progress safety during earlier probing and snapshot acknowledgment
already_covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: ReplicationEvidence requires a covering acknowledgment witness for nonself Match, independent of optimistic Next. QuotaIntegrity constrains inflight count/order; no old property asserts Next>Match. These remain necessary but cannot ensure that a probe is sent promptly or a snapshot acknowledgment changes the progress mode.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Unstable-term lookup and hard-state empty-check refactors
already_covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: Combining the nil-snapshot check in maybeTerm leaves its return cases identical. IsEmptyHardState replaces equality with the same empty value; recovery promises are unchanged. Log/storage test-message fixes and the stableTo last-entry index correction change no source contract.

already_covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Transfer request handling and positive-payload quota limits
already_covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: TransferContract already covers learner/unknown/same/self/lagging target decisions but observes no config callback. QuotaIntegrity intentionally permits an oversized first proposal and must not be changed to quota<=cap; the new zero-payload admission requires changes to decision predicates instead.

witness.state: A committed enter-joint entry is at index 6, pendingConf=6, raft.applied=5, and the caller has queued its Ready application but has not called ApplyConfChange yet.
witness.transition: Advance first sets applied=6 while AutoLeave is still false; then ApplyEntry installs AutoLeave=true. Later a normal entry 7 is committed and advanced; leader/quorums/services remain healthy. The new crossing guard sees oldApplied>=pendingConf forever and does not initiate a leave.
witness.old_property: The old AutoLeaveAdvance demands append-or-retry on the later cursor-7 Advance; simply replacing it with a crossing-only rule would lose this obligation. Old code can append on that later Advance with sufficient quota.
witness.proposed_property: AutoLeaveCompletion still rejects an infinite healthy execution that remains joint. Whether this caller ordering is excluded by a stricter documented configuration-callback contract must be resolved; ordinary early Advance is allowed by Node documentation.
